coverage_sentence: Coverage: every plausible topology with up to 6 free parameters from this pool was evaluated. That is a budget in parameters, not elements: it covers every topology of up to 3 elements in full, and no more, because CPE costs 2 parameters on its own -- a 4-element circuit built from it carries 8, past the budget, so it was never considered.
